title: Draft: CMake: Work around Homebrew's broken pkg-config.
description:
Homebrew configures pkg-config with
"--with-system-include-path=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/\<sdk\>/usr":
https://github.com/Homebrew/homebrew-core/blob/e2c833d326c45d9aaf4e26af6dd8b2f31564dc04/Formula/pkg-config.rb#L49

(On my system here, \<sdk\> is MacOSX10.15.sdk.)

CMake in turn passes "--variable=includedir" to pkg-config:
https://gitlab.kitware.com/cmake/cmake/-/blob/df4ed1e9/Modules/UsePkgConfig.cmake#L43

As a result, we end up finding the Libxml2 and zlib includes in
Homebrew's specified prefix. (The mismatched INCLUDE_DIR/_LIBRARY
prefixes look odd, but may not have anything to do with the issue at
hand.)

```
ag --nonumbers '^(libxml2|zlib)_(include_dir|library):' CMakeCache.txt
LIBXML2_INCLUDE_DIR:PATH=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX10.15.sdk/usr/include/libxml2
LIBXML2_LIBRARY:FILEPATH=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Platforms/MacOSX.platform/Developer/SDKs/MacOSX11.1.sdk/usr/lib/libxml2.tbd
ZLIB_INCLUDE_DIR:PATH=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX10.15.sdk/usr/include
ZLIB_LIBRARY:FILEPATH=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Platforms/MacOSX.platform/Developer/SDKs/MacOSX11.1.sdk/usr/lib/libz.tbd
```

On my system here, stdio.h under Homebrew's prefix has nullability
issues:

```
In file included from /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX10.15.sdk/usr/include/stdio.h:64:
/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX10.15.sdk/usr/include/_stdio.h:93:16: error: pointer is missing a nullability type specifier (_Nonnull, _Nullable, or _Null_unspecified) [-Werror,-Wnullability-completeness]
        unsigned char   *_base;
                        ^
```

If CMAKE_OSX_SYSROOT is defined and exists, make sure we search it first
for Libxml2 and zlib headers and libraries so that we bypass Homebrew.
Fixes #16868.

notes.body:
Marking as draft since I'm not entirely sure this is the correct fix.

I see the following behavior for each combination of master vs this branch and Xcode's developer directory vs the command line tools developer directory.

### master, `xcode-select --print-path` = /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer

```
$ cmake ...
[...]
Building for Mac OS X/OS X/macOS 10.13 using SDK /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Platforms/MacOSX.platform/Developer/SDKs/MacOSX11.1.sdk
[...]

$ ag --nonumbers '^(libxml2|zlib)_(include_dir|library):' CMakeCache.txt
LIBXML2_INCLUDE_DIR:PATH=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX10.15.sdk/usr/include/libxml2
LIBXML2_LIBRARY:FILEPATH=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Platforms/MacOSX.platform/Developer/SDKs/MacOSX11.1.sdk/usr/lib/libxml2.tbd
ZLIB_INCLUDE_DIR:PATH=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX10.15.sdk/usr/include
ZLIB_LIBRARY:FILEPATH=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Platforms/MacOSX.platform/Developer/SDKs/MacOSX11.1.sdk/usr/lib/libz.tbd
```

Build fails with nullability errors.


### This MR, `xcode-select --print-path` = /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer

```
$ cmake ... 
[...]
Building for Mac OS X/OS X/macOS 10.13 using SDK /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Platforms/MacOSX.platform/Developer/SDKs/MacOSX11.1.sdk
[...]

$ ag --nonumbers '^(libxml2|zlib)_(include_dir|library):' CMakeCache.txt
LIBXML2_INCLUDE_DIR:PATH=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Platforms/MacOSX.platform/Developer/SDKs/MacOSX11.1.sdk/usr/include/libxml2
LIBXML2_LIBRARY:FILEPATH=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Platforms/MacOSX.platform/Developer/SDKs/MacOSX11.1.sdk/usr/lib/libxml2.tbd
ZLIB_INCLUDE_DIR:PATH=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Platforms/MacOSX.platform/Developer/SDKs/MacOSX11.1.sdk/usr/include
ZLIB_LIBRARY:FILEPATH=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Platforms/MacOSX.platform/Developer/SDKs/MacOSX11.1.sdk/usr/lib/libz.tbd
```

Build succeeds.

### master, `xcode-select --print-path` = /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools

```
$ cmake ...
[...]
Building for Mac OS X/OS X/macOS 10.13 using SDK /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX11.1.sdk
[...]

$ ag --nonumbers '^(libxml2|zlib)_(include_dir|library):' CMakeCache.txt
LIBXML2_INCLUDE_DIR:PATH=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX10.15.sdk/usr/include/libxml2
LIBXML2_LIBRARY:FILEPATH=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX11.1.sdk/usr/lib/libxml2.tbd
ZLIB_INCLUDE_DIR:PATH=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX10.15.sdk/usr/include
ZLIB_LIBRARY:FILEPATH=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX11.1.sdk/usr/lib/libz.tbd
```

Build fails with nullability errors.

### This MR, `xcode-select --print-path` = /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools

```
$ cmake ...
[...]
Building for Mac OS X/OS X/macOS 10.13 using SDK /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX11.1.sdk
[...]

$ ag --nonumbers '^(libxml2|zlib)_(include_dir|library):' CMakeCache.txt`
LIBXML2_INCLUDE_DIR:PATH=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX11.1.sdk/usr/include/libxml2
LIBXML2_LIBRARY:FILEPATH=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX11.1.sdk/usr/lib/libxml2.tbd
ZLIB_INCLUDE_DIR:PATH=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX11.1.sdk/usr/include
ZLIB_LIBRARY:FILEPATH=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX11.1.sdk/usr/lib/libz.tbd
```

Build succeeds.

As commented in https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/issues/16868#note_505226348, I think this problem is caused by a pkg-config version which does not match the OS that is installed.

Instead of this workaround, I think that users should just `brew reinstall pkg-config` to address the root cause.

And for FindZLIB.cmake and FindLibXml2.cmake, ideally we should be able to copy the upstream files from CMake. That currently does not work due to the Windows library logic, but the situation is hopefully not made worse by customizations such as this one.

OK, it works if I reinstall pkg-config **and** run `xcode-select --switch /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools`. I'll go ahead and close this, but it would be nice if we could get Homebrew's pkg-config to play nice with the default developer root.

changes_data.diff:
@@ -50,6 +50,13 @@ The following cache variables may also be set:
 include(FindWSWinLibs)
 FindWSWinLibs("vcpkg-export-.*" LIBXML2_HINTS)
 
+# Homebrew forces pkg-config to return the prefix
+# /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/<sdk>/usr
+# https://github.com/Homebrew/homebrew-core/blob/e2c833d326c45d9aaf4e26af6dd8b2f31564dc04/Formula/pkg-config.rb#L49
+if (DEFINED CMAKE_OSX_SYSROOT AND EXISTS "${CMAKE_OSX_SYSROOT}/usr")
+    set (LIBXML2_HINTS "${CMAKE_OSX_SYSROOT}/usr")
+endif()
+
 # use pkg-config to get the directories and then use these values
 # in the find_path() and find_library() calls
 find_package(PkgConfig QUIET)
@@ -58,9 +65,9 @@ set(LIBXML2_DEFINITIONS ${PC_LIBXML_CFLAGS_OTHER})
 
 find_path(LIBXML2_INCLUDE_DIR NAMES libxml/xpath.h
    HINTS
+   ${LIBXML2_HINTS}/include
    ${PC_LIBXML_INCLUDEDIR}
    ${PC_LIBXML_INCLUDE_DIRS}
-   ${LIBXML2_HINTS}/include
    PATH_SUFFIXES libxml2
    )
 
@@ -73,9 +80,9 @@ endif()
 
 find_library(LIBXML2_LIBRARY NAMES xml2 libxml2 libxml2-2
    HINTS
+   ${LIBXML2_HINTS}/lib
    ${PC_LIBXML_LIBDIR}
    ${PC_LIBXML_LIBRARY_DIRS}
-   ${LIBXML2_HINTS}/lib
    )
 
 find_program(LIBXML2_XMLLINT_EXECUTABLE xmllint

@@ -39,6 +39,13 @@ include( FindWSWinLibs )
 # Zlib is included with GLib2
 FindWSWinLibs( "vcpkg-export-*" "ZLIB_HINTS" )
 
+# Homebrew forces pkg-config to return the prefix
+# /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/<sdk>/usr
+# https://github.com/Homebrew/homebrew-core/blob/e2c833d326c45d9aaf4e26af6dd8b2f31564dc04/Formula/pkg-config.rb#L49
+if (DEFINED CMAKE_OSX_SYSROOT AND EXISTS "${CMAKE_OSX_SYSROOT}/usr")
+    set (ZLIB_HINTS "${CMAKE_OSX_SYSROOT}/usr")
+endif()
+
 if (NOT ZLIB_INCLUDE_DIR OR NOT ZLIB_LIBRARY)
     find_package(PkgConfig)
     pkg_search_module(ZLIB zlib)
@@ -47,9 +54,9 @@ if (NOT ZLIB_INCLUDE_DIR OR NOT ZLIB_LIBRARY)
         NAMES
             zlib.h
         HINTS
-            "${ZLIB_INCLUDEDIR}"
             ${ZLIB_HINTS}/include
             ${ZLIB_HINTS}
+            "${ZLIB_INCLUDEDIR}"
         PATHS
             "[HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\\SOFTWARE\\GnuWin32\\Zlib;InstallPath]/include"
     )
@@ -59,9 +66,9 @@ if (NOT ZLIB_INCLUDE_DIR OR NOT ZLIB_LIBRARY)
         NAMES
             ${ZLIB_NAMES}
         HINTS
-            "${ZLIB_LIBDIR}"
-            ${ZLIB_HINTS}/lib
             ${ZLIB_HINTS}
+            ${ZLIB_HINTS}/lib
+            "${ZLIB_LIBDIR}"
         PATHS
             "[HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\\SOFTWARE\\GnuWin32\\Zlib;InstallPath]/lib"
     )
